title: Zephyr Cove Marina
specs: Parasailing offers unparalleled views and a dry experience
Mile-long sandy beach with volleyball courts and cocktail service
Must be at least 18 years old and have valid driver's license to rent and operate powerboat
Must be 16 years old with valid photo ID to drive a Wave Runner (Jet Ski)
Children must be at least 5 years old to ride on Jet Ski as passenger
Children must be at least 5 years old to participate in parasailing; those under 130 lbs must fly tandem with adult
To rent and drive a powerboat, must be at least 18 years old and have valid driver's license
Nevada boating safety education certificate required to operate motor vessels over 15 HP if born on or after Jan 1, 1983
includes: Wakeboards, wakesurf, tubes, and water skis available with powerboats
All gear and licenses available for fishing
gap: Exact duration options for powerboat rentals beyond hourly rates not fully detailed
blurb: Guests can rent various watercraft including powerboats, Jet Skis, kayaks, paddleboats, and stand-up paddleboards. Parasailing adventures provide aerial views of Lake Tahoe. The marina also offers beach activities, buoy rentals, and guided fishing trips with gear and licenses.
extraNote: Powerboats, Jet Skis, & Water Toys: Cancel >48 hrs before rental for full refund; within 48 hrs forfeit full deposit · Weekender Pontoon Boat: Cancel >72 hrs before rental for full refund; within 72 hrs forfeit full deposit · Pets prohibited at Zephyr Cove Marina/Beach and on Lake Tahoe cruise vessels · Parking daily fee $12/day in summer, waived in winter at Zephyr Cove Marina · Zephyr Cove Marina, Lake Tahoe
